content:
Dear mathlib community (and more generally the leanprover community),

For some time we've had some difficulties handling the mathlib pull-requests #queue, and a while ago we (the mathlib maintainer team) posted a brief message to let you know that we were working on a long-term solution. After a lot of back-and-forths, considerations, and reconsiderations, we have come up with some changes to the review process and a proposal for reorganising some of the structures in our community.

See general/mathlib organization for details.
